conservation.report_notes: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Smith College Museum of Art in 2025. Information lists analysis and treatment by Straus Center for Conservation and Technical Studies, Harvard University Art Museums, 1985 and Thornton Rockwell, 2002.
conservation.technical_description:
Recommendation to eventually have the painting surface cleaned (1985). 
Optional treatment by Thornton Rockwell, 2002.

other.content:
Smith College Museum of Art files indicate the inscription is at upper left and upside down on the verso: 
Stieglitz #1 (with the 1 circled) or Stieglitz A. 
(Source: Smith College Museum of Art, 2025)

materials.content:
Smith College Museum of Art refers to the oil on board more specifically as paperboard. It is also called “cardboard” in the Straus survey of paintings from 1985 and as “presdwood” [sic.] by conservator Thornton Rockwell (2002). 
(Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by Smith College Museum of Art, 2025)

cr_data.provenance: (The Downtown Gallery, New York, NY); Mr. and Mrs. Allan D. Emil, New York, NY, 1947 (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, April 1946. . . . On backing: In pencil by O'Keeffe, 'Squash Blossoms I' [not verified]. In ink by O'Keeffe, 'Georgia O'Keeffe – 1925'"[not verified]. Whitney Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks indicate, "Initials in circle"[not verified]. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
